title: The Best Cat-Themed Subscription Box Out There
text: I subscribed to the Pusheen Box for over a year and loved almost every item I received. I still use many of the items - mug, shower curtain, blanket, pillow cases, mini fan, you name it. The quality varies (some are made of rather inexpensive material from China that have that weird cheap factory smell and makes me worry if all the materials used are non-toxic) but the design is often irresistible. The only reason I stopped was because everything in my house was being taken over by Pusheen and it drove my spouse crazy. But if you love Pusheen and anything involving a cat, you'll find nirvana with this box.
label: positive
